# BracketRanker

> Free interactive bracket-style ranking tool: pick a category, choose winners head-to-head through elimination rounds, and get a shareable top-10 ranking. No signup required.

BracketRanker covers 100+ pre-built brackets across movies, music, TV, food, sports, and more. Every matchup is aggregated into community power rankings, and finished rankings get a unique shareable result page with an auto-generated image. Users can also build their own custom brackets and share them with friends.

## Core Tools

- [Bracket Maker](https://www.bracketranker.com/create): Build a custom bracket with your own items and share the link — no account needed
- [Tier List Maker](https://www.bracketranker.com/tier-list-maker): Rank anything head-to-head and generate a tiered list of your favorites
- [Leaderboard](https://www.bracketranker.com/leaderboard): Community power rankings aggregated from every matchup played on the site

## Category Hubs

- [Movies](https://www.bracketranker.com/movies): Rank the best movies ever made
- [Music](https://www.bracketranker.com/music): Rank songs, albums, and artists
- [TV](https://www.bracketranker.com/tv): Rank the best TV shows
- [Food](https://www.bracketranker.com/food): Rank food, drinks, and restaurants
- [Sports](https://www.bracketranker.com/sports): Rank teams, players, and GOATs
- [Random](https://www.bracketranker.com/random): Rank everything from dog breeds to superpowers
